{"triples": [{"subject": "Recursive Neural Networks", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphology", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "In this work, we use recursive neural networks , in a novel way to model morphology and its compositionality."}, {"subject": "RNNs", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphemes", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Essentially, we treat each morpheme as a basic unit in the RNNs and construct representations for morphologically complex words on the fly from their morphemes."}, {"subject": "Language Model", "predicate": "uses", "object": "contextual information", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "By training a neural language model (NLM) and integrating RNN structures for complex words , we utilize contextual information in 1An almost exception is the word clustering of , which does have a model of morphology to encourage words ending with the same suffix to appear in the same class, but it still does not capture the relationship between a word and its morphologically derived forms."}, {"subject": "analysis", "predicate": "uses", "object": "syntactic information", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "The detailed analysis in Section 6 reveals that our models can blend well syntactic information , i.e., the word structure, and the semantics in grouping related words ."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "Neural Network", "predicate": "addresses", "object": "NLP tasks", "object_type": "Task", "source_sentence": "Neural network techniques have found success in several NLP tasks recently such as sentiment analysis at the sentence and document level , language modeling , paraphrase detection , discriminative parsing , and tasks involving semantic relations and compositional meaning of phrases."}, {"subject": "Word Vector", "predicate": "uses", "object": "capitalization", "object_type": "Feature", "source_sentence": "(2011) enhanced word vectors with additional character-level features such as capitalization but still can not recover more detailed semantics for very rare or unseen words , which is the focus of this work."}]}

{"triples": [{"subject": "RNNs", "predicate": "uses", "object": "morphological compositionality", "object_type": "Concept", "source_sentence": "Our work does not simply concatenate vectors of morphemes, but rather combines them using RNNs, which captures morphological compositionality."}]}
